line_items.work_text: Ex Post Facto approval of fund released to DCs &ASDMA in 2025-26 for RG Fire/Storm/Ex-Gratia etc. (DBT)

Ex Post Facto approval for a total budget amounting to Rs. 17545.00 Lakhs released as advance budget under SDRF to the districts for repairing of damaged infrastructure against different sectors under respective departments
Ex Post facto Approval for an amount of Rs. 13047.44629 Lakh released by the Revenue & DM Department to the DCs, CDCs, SDO (C) and ASDMA for GR Flood
Ex Post facto Approval for an amount of Rs. 87.87053 Lakh released by the Revenue & DM Department to the DCs and CDCs for GR Cyclone
Ex- Post facto approval amounting to Rs. 97.29869 lakh for commissioning of the Doppler Weather Radars (DWR) at Guwahati, Tezpur and Silchar

narrative: SEC took note of the amendment made to the Assam State Disaster Management Rules 2010 enabling State Disaster Management Authority to make regulations governing the service conditions of ASDMA employees.
